{{Quote|First those terrorists, now a Jedi?|Trabier|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Trabier''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Head of manufacture]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He had a powerful [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] bodyguard named [[Lerek Serrus]], who was convinced to defect by a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]]. The Jedi Consular had arrived to gain the support of [[Zenith]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] displeased with the Empire's presence on Balmorra. Following that, Trabier was arrested and taken into custody.<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Trabier appears in the Jedi Consular class mission entitled "Our Points Of View" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
